e7_role: Evidence sufficiency for the title/abstract scientific judgment. E7=NO or UNCERTAIN cannot produce INCLUDE and results in a deferred operational disposition when no scientific NO is present.
rules: A defensible NO in E1-E5 yields EXCLUDED and operational EXCLUDE with an evidence-supported reason.
Without an E1-E5 NO, unresolved E1-E5 evidence or E7=NO/UNCERTAIN yields UNCERTAIN and operational DEFER.
Missing abstract yields DEFER in this round even when title-only criterion judgments were permitted under protocol 2.0.0.
INCLUDE with verified available full report advances to full-report assessment; INCLUDE with unavailable full report is DEFER.
DEFER is not an exclusion criterion or a final eligibility judgment.
Deferred records may be revisited only for a documented synthesis gap, never to reach a target paper count.
limitations: no claim of independent validation from this pilot
